# dsh-see-now

Source: https://github.com/SAOS-3624/dsh-see-now/tree/7270d85b1e3518b9af243f571cdf01e5da2aad0d

The vendored files retain their Apache-2.0 license and upstream NOTICE.
`capture.js` was adapted to crop by relative display coordinates and preserve
the source aspect ratio. `pipeline.js` adds a method to flush already selected
frames. The remaining JavaScript files are unchanged.
